facts.fact: Renewal is applied online on sarathi.parivahan.gov.in: select the State, then 'Services on Drivers License (Renewal/Duplicate/AEDL/Others)' in the Driving License menu
facts.quote: Steps follow to apply for RENEWAL of License :- 1. Visit https://sarathi.parivahan.gov.in/ 2. Select concerned state 3. Click on "Services on Drivers License(Renewal/Duplicate/AEDL/Others)" from "Driving License" menu 4. Fill up application form
facts.note: Sarathi's own menu (rendered HTML, 28 Oct 2026) labels it 'Services on DL (Renewal/Duplicate/AEDL/IDP/Others)' and also offers an 'Apply for DL Renewal' link.

facts.fact: The applicant enters the DL number and date of birth to fetch the licence details
facts.quote: 5. Enter "Drivers License number" and "Date of birth" click "Get Drivers License Details"

facts.fact: The service 'RENEWAL OF DL' is selected, choosing the RTO covering the current address
facts.note: Stated on Sarathi's dlServicesDet.do, which the checker could not fetch on 28 Oct 2026 (IncompleteRead on every attempt); a person should confirm it there.

facts.fact: Because the applicant is 40 or older, the renewal application must be accompanied by a medical certificate (MV Act s.15(1) proviso)
facts.quote: Provided further that where the application is for the renewal of a licence to drive a transport vehicle or where in any other case the applicant has attained the age of forty years, the same shall be accompanied by a medical certificate

facts.fact: The medical certificate for applicants aged 40 or above is Form 1A
facts.quote: Medical Certificate (FORM 1A) is required for applicants having age equal to or above 40 years, in case of less than 40 you need to submit FORM 1.

facts.fact: Sarathi's State service page lists a 'Find Doctor' service
facts.quote: Upload Document Online LLTest(STALL) Find Doctor
facts.note: The page shows the 'Find Doctor' service; the words 'empanelled doctor' are on dlServicesDet.do / doctorsReport.do, which the checker could not fetch on 28 Oct 2026.

facts.fact: Renewal can be done within one year before or after the expiry of the licence
facts.quote: As per the latest amendment of CMV Act, renewal of a driving License could be done within one year prior to or after the expiry of the Driving License.

facts.fact: If the licence expired more than one year ago, a driving test may be required as per State policy
facts.quote: To Renewal license after one year expire one needs to undergo a Driving test, as per state policy.

facts.fact: For an applicant aged 55 or more, a renewed non-transport licence is valid for 5 years (MV Act s.14(2)(b)(iv))
facts.quote: (iv) has attained the age of fifty-five years on the date of issue or as the case may be, renewal thereof, be effective for a period of five years from the date of such issue or renewal.
facts.note: The Parivahan FAQ says the same: 'If the age of the applicant on the date of issue or renewal is >=55, then the Non Transport validity would be effective for a period of 5 years'.

facts.fact: Then upload documents (and photo/signature where required), pay the fee, verify the payment and print the receipt
facts.note: These stages are on Sarathi's dlServicesDet.do, which the checker could not fetch on 28 Oct 2026; the Parivahan FAQ only says to fill the form, click Next and visit the RTO with original documents and the fee slip.

summary: Renewal path, 40+ medical certificate (MV Act s.15, Form 1A), one-year window, State-policy test and 55+ five-year validity confirmed; Sarathi's renewal-stage page could not be fetched (2 facts manual).
